card.title: 178th GUARD RIFLES

card.flavorText: The 178th Guards Rifle Regiment served as a frontline unit of the 58th Guards Rifle Division, which was formed in December 1942 from the battle-hardened 1st Rifle Division. The division was raised to Guards status for its actions during the Soviet counteroffensive at Stalingrad and became part of the 64th Army, later redesignated as the 7th Guards Army. As part of the 58th Division, the 178th Regiment saw extensive combat across the Eastern Front. It fought in the brutal campaigns of 1943, including the battles for the Donbass and the Dnieper River. In 1944, the regiment took part in Operation Bagration, contributing to the liberation of Belarus and the destruction of the German Army Group Centre. The division’s advance continued through eastern Poland and into East Prussia in early 1945. It was decorated with numerous awards, including the Order of the Red Banner and the Order of Suvorov.
